issues: TypeScript compile error in src/navigation/index.tsx: the icon name 'run-outline' is not assignable to the MaterialCommunityIcons name type, causing tsc failure.

UI flow primary flow test fails at step 22: the mini FAB button labelled "Receipt" is not found because FABAdd hides the mini FABs until the main FAB is opened. The test expects the "Receipt" button to be directly clickable.
feedback: Fix the TypeScript error by relaxing the type of the tabIcon parameter (e.g., use a string) or by using a valid icon name. Ensure the mini FABs are visible without needing to press the main FAB (e.g., set the initial open state to true) and optionally add accessibilityRole="button" to them. After these changes, the app should compile and pass the UI flow test.
